description: This file provides Windows-specific implementations for memory mapping functions, including git_mmap and git_munmap, utilizing Win32 API calls such as CreateFileMapping, MapViewOfFileEx, and UnmapViewOfFile.

methods.name: void * git_mmap(void * start,size_t length,int prot,int flags,int fd,off_t offset)
methods.description: Creates a mapped view of a file, similar to POSIX mmap, using Windows API functions.

methods.name: int git_munmap(void * start,size_t length UNUSED)
methods.description: Unmaps a previously mapped view of a file, similar to POSIX munmap.
